summary: Allocates an array whose element count depends on the char flag a2: 64 elements when a2 is non-zero, otherwise 32. Requests 12 * count bytes from OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (00587C03). On success runs a loop that calls WrapperPassThrough (004B4450) on each 12-byte element before storing the array pointer into this+0x0; on failure stores a null pointer into this+0x0. Returns this in both paths. Called by CarPhysicsStateInitializer (004B57F0) and sub_4B7860.

local_names.this: owner whose field at offset 0x0 receives the allocated array pointer
local_names.a2: char flag selecting the element count (non-zero: 64, zero: 32)
local_names.v3: element count, initialized from a2 and decremented by the initialization loop
local_names.v5: walking pointer advanced by 12 bytes per element during initialization

operations.description: v3 = a2 != 0 ? 64 : 32 chooses the element count from the char flag
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12 * v3) requests an array of 12-byte elements; 12 is the element stride
If v4 (allocation result) is null, skip the initialization loop and store a null pointer into this+0x0
Iterates v3 times starting at v5 = v4: calls WrapperPassThrough(v5), advances v5 by 12 bytes and decrements v3 until v3 reaches zero
*this = v4 stores the allocated array pointer on success, or *this = 0 on allocation failure
Returns this on both the success and failure paths
Called by CarPhysicsStateInitializer (004B57F0) and sub_4B7860, both plausibly construction paths for the owning object

unresolved: The meaning of the 12-byte element stride and the 64/32 element counts is not documented; 32 may be a base grid size and 64 an expanded variant
WrapperPassThrough (004B4450) semantics are unknown; the loop likely performs default construction or zero-initialization of each element
The owner type is unknown; the prelabel only claims a structural twin of ObjectAllocator (0045bb90) at DERIVED trust
The a2 flag's source enum or meaning is not recoverable from this function alone
